description: A PHP class definition for handling job specification file operations within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. Extends functionality from AbstractFileController to manage file retrieval, setting response headers, and interacting with JobTitleService to fetch attachments.

classes.name: JobSpecification
classes.description: Handles the retrieval and serving of job specification attachment files in the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.
